$comment: failed checks that have no CloudFormation counterpart (no CloudFormation check with
the same id or the same policy text), so nothing can be compared with them.
One entry per check id with one reason, and a pinned count per Terraform resource
type. A check id with no entry fails the gate, as does a count above its pin; a count
below its pin fails as stale, and the message gives the number to lower it to.
A reason says what is accepted and why, what CloudFormation-side setting covers it,
or that it is a known gap and where the fix belongs.

CKV_AWS_50.name: X-Ray tracing is enabled for Lambda
CKV_AWS_50.reason: Won't fix, by decision: Lambda tracing is optional on purpose. The templates on the processing path declare the EnableXRayTracing parameter (default true) and EnableXRayTracingCondition, every function that opts in writes Tracing: !If [EnableXRayTracingCondition, Active, PassThrough] so the deployer can turn it off, and scripts/tests/test_xray_tracing.py holds that no function hardcodes a mode while deliberately not requiring any particular function to be traced. 98 of these are functions whose templates set no Tracing, which leaves them on PassThrough whatever the parameter says; that is accepted. Four are the functions of the custom-resource bridge the translator adds (terraform/translator/idp_tf/static_files.py), which run only during apply and destroy. The other 10 are root-module functions whose tracing_config is the EnableXRayTracingCondition expression, which checkov does not resolve in the root module; the same expression passes in every nested module. No CloudFormation-side suppression is needed: checkov has no CloudFormation counterpart of this check, and the SRT register records LAMBDA-004 (no X-Ray tracing) where SRT reports it.

CKV_AWS_144.name: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled
CKV_AWS_144.reason: Accepted. No bucket in the template has cross-region replication; the solution deploys to one region and replication is a disaster-recovery choice for the deployer. The 17 are the template's buckets and the bridge bucket of the custom-resource bridge the translator adds to every module with custom resources (terraform/translator/idp_tf/static_files.py), whose objects are regenerated by every apply.

CKV_AWS_145.name: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
CKV_AWS_145.reason: Accepted, per bucket. LoggingBucket: S3 server access logging can deliver only to a bucket with SSE-S3 default encryption, so SSE-KMS is not available to it. WebUIBucket: SSE-S3 as in the template; it holds the UI's static build, served to every browser. The bridge buckets of the custom-resource bridge the translator adds use the stack's customer-managed key and pass.

CKV_AWS_272.name: Ensure AWS Lambda function is configured to validate code-signing
CKV_AWS_272.reason: Accepted. No function in the templates has a CodeSigningConfigArn (the solution publishes no signing profile), and the generated functions match; code signing is a deployment choice that needs a signing profile and a signed artifact pipeline. Includes the four bridge functions of the custom-resource bridge the translator adds to every module with custom resources (terraform/translator/idp_tf/static_files.py).

CKV_AWS_310.name: Ensure CloudFront distributions should have origin failover configured
CKV_AWS_310.reason: Accepted. The UI distribution has one S3 origin in the deployment's region and no second region to fail over to; the template is the same.

CKV_AWS_316.name: Ensure CodeBuild project environments do not have privileged mode enabled
CKV_AWS_316.reason: Accepted. The two image builds (patterns/unified and multi-doc-discovery DockerBuildProject) run docker build, which needs CodeBuild privileged mode. The UI build (UICodeBuildProject) runs npm and the AWS CLI only, has PrivilegedMode false, and passes; scripts/tests/test_template_security_hardening.py fails if its buildspec gains a Docker command.

CKV_AWS_338.name: Ensure CloudWatch log groups retains logs for at least 1 year
CKV_AWS_338.reason: Accepted. Retention is the deployer's LogRetentionDays parameter (default 30 days, up to 3653), applied as in the template; checkov wants at least 365 days. Includes the root UI build's log group (UICodeBuildLogGroup) and the four bridge log groups of the custom-resource bridge the translator adds (terraform/translator/idp_tf/static_files.py), fixed at 30 days.

CKV_AWS_355.name: Ensure no IAM policies documents allow "*" as a statement's resource for restrictable actions
CKV_AWS_355.reason: Accepted, per statement; each is a template statement translated verbatim with Resource *, and each carries a recorded reason on the CloudFormation side. DashboardMergerFunction (cloudwatch:GetDashboard, PutDashboard, DeleteDashboards): cfn_nag W11 'Role requires * resource access for CloudWatch Dashboards'; note that those three actions do accept a dashboard ARN (only ListDashboards does not), so that recorded reason is weaker than it reads and scoping them to the stack's dashboards is a possible follow-up. S3VectorManagerRole (bedrock:GetKnowledgeBase, UpdateKnowledgeBase, DeleteKnowledgeBase): cfn_nag W11, whose reason says the knowledge base control plane is unscoped because the knowledge base id is service-generated and does not exist at create time. StartUICodeBuildExecutionRole and the pattern stack's CodeBuildExecutionRole (logs:CreateLogGroup, CreateLogStream, PutLogEvents): cfn_nag W11 and checkov CKV_AWS_111 skips, 'Write access required for CloudWatch Logs and CloudFormation custom resource operations'. AgentCoreGatewayManagerFunction (logs:DeleteDeliverySource, DeleteDeliveryDestination): cfn_nag W11 'AgentCore Gateway ARNs are dynamically generated and unknown at deployment time' and F3, which names these deletes as removing the delivery resources older gateways created. BDAOCRProjectFunction (ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, DeleteNetworkInterface, under DeployInVPC): the network interface actions a VPC-attached Lambda needs, granted on * as AWS's managed AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole grants them; no CloudFormation-side suppression records this one. BDAProcessResultsFunctionRole's ssm:GetParameter/PutParameter on * is gone from the template (nothing in that function reads Parameter Store).

CKV2_AWS_32.name: Ensure CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy attached
CKV2_AWS_32.reason: Scanner limitation, not a gap. The distribution has the template's security-headers policy attached (response_headers_policy_id = awscc_cloudfront_response_headers_policy.security_headers_policy). checkov's graph rule only recognises a connection to an aws_cloudfront_response_headers_policy resource, and the translator emits that policy through the awscc provider.

CKV2_AWS_42.name: Ensure AWS CloudFront distribution uses custom SSL certificate
CKV2_AWS_42.reason: Accepted, and covered on the CloudFormation side: the template serves the UI on the CloudFront default certificate (ViewerCertificate CloudFrontDefaultCertificate true) and skips CKV_AWS_174 for that reason; a custom certificate needs a customer-owned domain, which the template does not take for the distribution.

CKV2_AWS_47.name: Ensure AWS CloudFront attached WAFv2 WebACL is configured with AMR for Log4j Vulnerability
CKV2_AWS_47.reason: Accepted, and covered on the CloudFormation side: the UI distribution has no WAF web ACL at all, which the template records by skipping CKV_AWS_68 ('WAF is optional and can be enabled by customer'), so there is no web ACL for a Log4j managed rule group to be missing from. The backend is Python.

CKV2_AWS_61.name: Ensure that an S3 bucket has a lifecycle configuration
CKV2_AWS_61.reason: Accepted. EvaluationBaselineBucket holds user-curated ground truth, which has no expiry on purpose; the template is the same and its SRT S3-008 suppression says so. WebUIBucket has a lifecycle rule expiring noncurrent UI builds and passes.

CKV2_AWS_62.name: Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled
CKV2_AWS_62.reason: Accepted. Event notifications are configured where something consumes them (the input, discovery, output and other processing buckets send to EventBridge, and pass); these are buckets nothing reacts to: logging, web UI, working, reporting, test-set, fine-tuning, MCP content, evaluation baseline, and the bridge bucket of the custom-resource bridge the translator adds to every module with custom resources (terraform/translator/idp_tf/static_files.py). The template is the same.

CKV2_AWS_65.name: Ensure access control lists for S3 buckets are disabled
CKV2_AWS_65.reason: Accepted, as the template documents: LoggingBucket uses ObjectOwnership BucketOwnerPreferred because CloudFront standard logging delivers log files through ACLs, which BucketOwnerEnforced disables.
